title: JBL Bar 9.1 General Error
shortDescription: A general error on the JBL Bar 9.1 indicating system fault.
fullDescription:
The JBL Bar 9.1 displays a generic error when internal communication between the main bar and detachable rear speakers fails.

Reseating the battery speakers on the dock and rebooting typically clears the error.

fixSteps.title: Redock rear speakers
fixSteps.instruction: Attach the rear speakers to the main bar for 30 minutes to re-sync.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug main bar for 60 seconds and plug back in.

whenToCallPro: If rear speakers don't charge after redocking.

faq.q: How long do rear speakers last?

title: JBL Soundbar WiFi Setup Failed
shortDescription: Initial WiFi setup through the JBL One app failed.
fullDescription:
The JBL One app walks through WiFi provisioning, but setup may fail if the network is 5GHz only (some older JBL bars are 2.4GHz) or if router security is WPA3.

Switching to a 2.4GHz SSID and WPA2 usually resolves the issue.

fixSteps.title: Enable 2.4GHz SSID
fixSteps.instruction: Turn on the 2.4GHz band on the router and use that SSID.

fixSteps.title: Use WPA2
fixSteps.instruction: Switch security mode to WPA2 or WPA2/WPA3 mixed.

whenToCallPro: Only if router is managed by ISP.

faq.a: Some models offer Ethernet for more stable setup.

title: JBL HDMI ARC No Signal
shortDescription: No audio coming in through HDMI ARC.
fullDescription: The soundbar input is set to HDMI but no signal is received from the TV. The most common causes are disabled CEC, wrong HDMI port, or a non-ARC capable cable.

fixSteps.title: Use ARC port
fixSteps.instruction: Connect HDMI to the TV's ARC/eARC labeled port.

videoSearchQuery: JBL HDMI ARC no signal fix

faq.q: Why is my cable not ARC?
faq.a: Older high-speed cables without Ethernet may miss ARC pins.

title: JBL Bluetooth Pairing Issue
shortDescription: Phone will not pair to the JBL soundbar.
fullDescription:
Phone or tablet cannot pair via Bluetooth. Usually caused by a full pairing list on the soundbar or the phone trying to connect to an old cached entry.

Resetting Bluetooth on the soundbar and forgetting the device on the phone clears the state.

fixSteps.title: Forget device on phone
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the JBL device from the phone's paired list.

fixSteps.title: Hold Bluetooth button
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Bluetooth on the remote for 5 seconds to enter pairing mode.

faq.a: Only one active, but several can be remembered.

title: JBL Dolby Atmos Not Working
shortDescription: Soundbar does not show Atmos indicator during Atmos content.
fullDescription:
For Atmos to pass to the soundbar the TV must support eARC (or Atmos pass-through on ARC) and the source app must be configured for Atmos output.

Streaming services like Netflix require a Premium plan for Atmos content.

causes.cause: Source app not set to Atmos

fixSteps.title: Check TV specs
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm TV supports eARC or Atmos pass-through.

fixSteps.title: Enable bitstream
fixSteps.instruction: Set TV audio output to Auto/Bitstream/Dolby Digital Plus.

whenToCallPro: If TV needs replacement to support eARC.
videoSearchQuery: JBL Dolby Atmos not working fix

faq.a: For lossless Atmos, yes; lossy Atmos works over regular ARC.

title: JBL Subwoofer Pairing Failed
shortDescription: Wireless subwoofer lost pairing with the soundbar.
fullDescription:
JBL soundbars pair wirelessly with their subwoofer at the factory, but connections can be lost after firmware updates or power disruption.

A manual pairing procedure using the rear buttons re-establishes the link.

fixSteps.title: Manual pair
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the pair button on both soundbar and sub for 5 seconds.

whenToCallPro: If sub fails to power on.

faq.a: Keep subwoofer within 10 meters of the soundbar.

title: JBL Room Calibration Error
fullDescription:
JBL's room calibration uses built-in mics to analyze the room. It can fail in very loud rooms, with soft furnishings blocking mics, or when the soundbar is too close to walls.

Clear the area, reduce ambient noise, and retry.

fixSteps.title: Silence the room
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off HVAC and close doors.

fixSteps.title: Move soundbar 30cm out
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure 30cm clearance from walls before retry.

faq.a: After rearranging furniture or moving the bar.

title: JBL Firmware Update Stuck
shortDescription: Firmware update progresses slowly or stalls.
fullDescription: Updates over WiFi can stall if the network is weak or drops packets. Using USB firmware update (supported on some models) or wired LAN resolves the issue.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle and retry
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 60 seconds, then retry update.

fixSteps.title: USB update
fixSteps.instruction: If supported, download firmware to USB from JBL website and update via USB.

faq.a: Yes if downloaded from JBL's official site.

title: JBL Soundbar Won't Turn On
shortDescription: Soundbar does not respond to power.
fullDescription:
A dead JBL soundbar could indicate failed AC adapter, power board damage, or firmware hang.

Try another outlet and an extended unplug before seeking service.

fixSteps.title: Long unplug
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 2 minutes, plug into a known outlet.

whenToCallPro: If still dead after power cycle.
videoSearchQuery: JBL soundbar won't turn on fix

title: JBL Output Volume Too Low
fullDescription:
Low output often arises from audio limiting settings, Night Mode being on, or the source device sending a digital attenuated signal.

Check soundbar and TV audio limiting first.

fixSteps.title: Turn off Night mode
fixSteps.instruction: Press Night button on remote to toggle off.

fixSteps.title: Check TV audio settings
fixSteps.instruction: Disable volume leveling/auto volume on TV.

videoSearchQuery: JBL soundbar volume too low fix

faq.a: No but it's easy to toggle accidentally.

title: ARC Handshake Issue
shortDescription: JBL bar via ARC has no sound.
fullDescription: JBL Bar 5.1/9.1/1000 connected via HDMI ARC produces no audio.
videoSearchQuery: JBL No Audio HDMI ARC fix

faq.a: Yes - use TOSLINK if ARC continues to fail.

title: Battery Module Issue
fullDescription: Bar 5.1/9.1 detachable surround speakers not charging when docked to bar.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe dock and module contacts with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Reseat firmly
fixSteps.instruction: Align magnets and seat module fully.

whenToCallPro: If contacts intact but no charge.
videoSearchQuery: JBL Detachable Speaker Not Charging fix

title: Wireless Sub Lost
fullDescription: Wireless sub fails to pair with the bar - blinking white instead of solid.

fixSteps.title: Pair button
fixSteps.instruction: Hold pair on rear of sub for 5 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Move closer
fixSteps.instruction: Place sub within 30 feet of bar.

faq.a: Should pair once and stay - re-pair only after move.

title: BT Discovery Issue
fullDescription: Phone Bluetooth does not see or fails to pair with the JBL bar.

fixSteps.title: Enter pair mode
fixSteps.instruction: Press BT source button until LED blinks rapidly.

fixSteps.title: Forget on phone
fixSteps.instruction: Remove old pairing on phone, retry.

title: Auto Calibration Error
fullDescription: Bar 9.1 self-calibration aborts - room layout or noise issue.

fixSteps.title: Place surrounds
fixSteps.instruction: Position rear surround modules at listening positions before running.

faq.a: Yes but Atmos benefits from calibration.

title: Cast Discovery Fail
shortDescription: Cast button does not show JBL.
fullDescription: JBL Bar with Chromecast built-in not visible to cast-capable apps.

fixSteps.title: Same WiFi
fixSteps.instruction: Phone and bar on same SSID/VLAN.

faq.a: Some models support both Cast and AirPlay 2.

title: Source Decoding Dolby
fullDescription: Front display shows DOLBY meaning Dolby Digital or Atmos is being decoded - normal info.

faq.a: Bar shows DOLBY ATMOS specifically when Atmos detected.

title: Update Hung
fullDescription: Bar firmware update appears frozen at percentage for over 10 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Wait 20 min
fixSteps.instruction: Some updates take longer than indicator suggests.

faq.a: Low - bar typically reverts to last good firmware.

title: IR or Battery Issue
fullDescription: JBL bar remote unresponsive - battery, IR, or pairing.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Install fresh CR2025 or AAA per model.

fixSteps.title: Clear path
fixSteps.instruction: Remove obstructions in front of bar.

faq.a: Yes - JBL One app provides full control.
